chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Mas'ud, who said:

I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) arrive at the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), so he placed his hand upon it and said: 'I ask Allah, Who selected you and chose you and guided you and guided (us) through you, that He should send blessings upon you.'
Then he said: 'Surely Allah and His Angels send blessings upon the Prophet; O you who believe! Send blessings upon him and submit to him with a (complete) submission.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say when visiting the grave of the Prophet?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Imams' direct spiritual connection to the Prophet's grave, emphasizing supplication for his honor as the chosen guide. By reciting Surah Al-Ahzab 33:56, Imam al-Sadiq links the believers' duty of sending blessings to the divine command, reinforcing the theological significance of the Prophet's station in Shia tradition.
